caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a human figure standing on a decorated rectangular base. The figure is dressed in a long brown robe with yellow and black trim, which is tied at the waist with a yellow belt. The robe has voluminous sleeves with lighter brown on the inside. The figure's feet are visible wearing yellow sandals, and the hem of a blue garment peeks out beneath the robe. The figure has pale skin, short black hair, and a downward tilted face with a neutral expression, and is holding its hands up at chest height, palms facing outward. A halo-like circular object colored with yellow and orange stripes is positioned behind the head. The base of the statue is decorated with red, green, and pink floral designs against a yellow background with geometric green accents. The number "37" is printed in the lower left corner of the image. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Plate 37: Saint Anthony: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
